title: The panel has a Transitions group of tiles, as the transitions mock draws it
goal: The transitions mock shows a Transitions group in the right panel: a searchable grid of transition tiles you can drag onto a cut, with a plus menu holding Apply to every cut and Set as the default transition. Today the tiles only appear in the small picker that opens at a cut, so there is nowhere to browse transitions without first clicking a cut.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video-transitions.html, the dgrp with the libgrid #lib (lines ~240-260) and #efxMenu (line ~299). The verbs already exist: EditorState.putTransitionOnEveryCut(_:among:) and setDefaultTransition(_:) (EditorState+ClipTransitions.swift); tiles are VideoKit.Tile + AnimatedTransitionThumbnail as in TransitionPicker.swift. Found while building one-step-puts-a-transition-on-every-cut, which put Apply to Every Cut on the picker tile right click only.
acceptance: The right panel of a video document shows a Transitions group with the six tiles and a search field, as the mock lays it out
Dragging a tile onto a cut on the timeline puts that transition on the cut, as one undo step
The group header plus menu offers Apply to Every Cut and Set as Default Transition, doing what the picker tile right click already does
A walk at Next defaults proves it and an audit carries a real picture beside the mock
